ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with approximately 5-10% high-intensity (white) pixel distribution concentrated in localized spots and scars.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Scattered high-intensity focal spots across both lobes; a prominent diagonal white linear feature on the mid-left lobe; dense high-intensity pixel clustering at the distal tip of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate interior angle of 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge; left lobe exhibits low-amplitude serrations; right lobe contains a significant, deep rectangular-shaped tissue void approximately 75% distal from the center.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve with lobes sweeping dorsally toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-contrast pixel clusters (1-10 pixel diameter) consistent with barnacle scars, most numerous on the right fluke tip and central fluke body.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single, distinct diagonal high-intensity linear mark on the left lobe; evidence of faint parallel horizontal linear disruptions on the lower right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant tissue loss on the right trailing edge forming a large, sharp-edged rectangular indentation.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly asymmetrical trailing edge morphology due to the large indentation on the right lobe compared to the jagged but continuous edge of the left lobe.
